_note: Job B batch 1. Every row is a reader judgment: either the claim the assertion points back at, or a demotion because the cue fired on something that is not an assertion that a word landed. Two rows are held back for a seeding pass, because the word he points at is not yet a canonical claim.

links.points_back_to: the window he says was given, which he expects others to call a golden age
links.real_event: The current financial window, offered as the thing he saw.

links.points_back_to: not an assertion that a word landed: he is recounting a vision of the glory, in the future tense, and the cue fired on the recounting
not an assertion that a word landed: a restatement of the migration vision, still forward-looking
the sonic boom he saw breaking glass out of houses and cars, running from California across America
links.real_event: A boom event he calls similar but which caused no damage, which he says himself.

links.points_back_to: not a prophecy at all: a personal instruction about not letting people have constant access to him
